name: obsidian-dsh-acp
description: Expose DeepSeek Harness (DSH) over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients). Install as a Custom Agent in Obsidian, or as a cordis plugin in a DSH profile, to drive DSH right from Obsidian — list/resume/fork sessions, run the harness, and archive conversations.
